page.overview:
What is Kingslayers?

The Kingslayers, also known as Assassins of Kings, were an organization made up of a handful of witchers from the School of the Viper in the service of Nilfgaardian Imperator Emhyr var Emreis. The organization's task was to spread chaos in the kingdoms of the North by killing their kings with Letho of Gulet as the leader.

On the 25th of July, 1270 Letho was wounded by a Slyzard. Saved by Geralt he and two other Viper Witchers, Serrit and Auckes, would aid in Geralt's quest to rescue Yennefer of Vengerberg. After Geralt traded places with her in the Wild Hunt they took her into their care. They eventually made their way into Nilfgaard, where they arrested and given a mission by Vattier de Rideaux and the Imperator Emhyr var Emreis in exchange for freedom and the rebuilding of their School. The mission was to destabilize the Northern Kingdoms by assassinating monarchs. Letho agreed, gathered his comrades and traveling north.

Originally Letho planned Esterad Thyssen, king of Kovir and Poviss, to be the first victim but before he could act he was hired by Síle de Tansarville and Philippa Eilhart to assassinate Aedirnian King Demavend III. This was part of a conspiracy by the Lodge of Sorceresses to maintain control over the North.

On September 1270, a masked kingslayer entered to Royal Palace in Vizima and attempted to kill Foltest but the monarch was defended by Geralt. The assassin was eliminated and in the aftermath they uncovered he bore the cat-eye mutations of a witcher. He would be collected by the king's medics who would perform an autopsy. What remained a month later would be delivered to the mage Triss who could only determine he could see in the dark as good as Geralt and that his age was unclear, suggesting he was a witcher.
